title: Otter holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M50 38 Q54 50 50 62' stroke='#cfe8ff' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none'/>
  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='#ff4d6d'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='26' rx='13' ry='15' fill='none' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='21' rx='4' ry='5' fill='#ffb3c1'/>
  <polygon points='47,41 53,41 50,45' fill='#e63956'/>
  <!-- otter body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#a9702f'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#e0b878'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='55' rx='15' ry='13' fill='#b97e3a'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='37' cy='47' r='4' fill='#8f5d24'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='47' r='4' fill='#8f5d24'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='60' rx='9' ry='7' fill='#f0cfa0'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='53' r='2.6' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='53' r='2.6' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='52.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff2d8'/>
  <circle cx='56.8' cy='52.2' r='0.9' fill='#fff2d8'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='58' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 60 Q47 63 45 61 M50 60 Q53 63 55 61' stroke='#6b4a22' stroke-width='1.1' fill='none'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M41 59 L34 57 M41 61 L34 62 M59 59 L66 57 M59 61 L66 62' stroke='#cfa070' stroke-width='0.9'/>
  <!-- arm holding balloon -->
  <path d='M63 68 Q68 64 60 61' stroke='#8f5d24' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='61' r='2.6' fill='#8f5d24'/>
  <!-- other arm -->
  <path d='M38 72 Q33 76 36 80' stroke='#8f5d24' stroke-width='5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='89' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#8f5d24'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='89' rx='6' ry='3.5' fill='#8f5d24'/>
</svg>
